tools.name: chercher_annonces
tools.description: Search Mission Museaux's listings of lost, found and stray pets in France near a town or point, by species, breed, colour, sex, date or words. Use statut trouve_ou_errant for a lost pet, perdu for a found one. Returns up to 25 listings with photo, dates, source and link. Accepts French or English; r

tools.name: voir_annonce
tools.description: Read one listing or adoptable animal in full after a search, by the id or url from chercher_annonces, chercher_par_photo or chercher_adoptions. Returns description, marks, dates, source, photos and sightings, or temperament, health and fee. Never returns contact details. Accepts French or English; r

tools.name: chercher_par_photo
tools.description: Find LISTINGS whose photo looks like a pet photo (https url or base64), to see if a lost or found animal was reported. To only identify a breed, use reconnaitre_race. Returns up to 10 listings with likeness %, dates and source, plus a breed estimate. Photo not stored. Accepts French or English; repl

tools.name: chercher_adoptions
tools.description: Search cats and dogs for adoption in France, at Mission Museaux and other shelters, near a town, in a department or region, or nationwide, by breed, sex, age and gets-on-with. Returns up to 25 animals with shelter, fee, photo, dates and link; else the closest within 300 km. Accepts French or English

tools.name: obtenir_conseils
tools.description: Get Mission Museaux's step-by-step advice for one situation: lost pet, found animal, kittens outdoors, injured animal, stray cats, mistreatment, identification (microchip, I-CAD) or adoption. Use it when someone asks what to do. Returns steps, FAQ and links, for France. Accepts French or English; re

tools.name: chercher_races
tools.description: Look up dog and cat breeds in Mission Museaux's directory by full or partial name, or list the most common. Use it to check a breed name. Returns French and English names, other names, FCI standard, origin, listings and adoptions per breed, and its page. Dogs and cats only. Accepts French or English

tools.name: reconnaitre_race
tools.description: Estimate the BREED of a dog or cat on a photo (https or base64), or the kind of bird or small pet (budgerigar, rabbit…). For matching listings, use chercher_par_photo. Returns likely breeds with shares, type or mix, and pages; an estimate, not a certainty. Photo not stored. Accepts French or English

tools.name: chercher_missions_benevolat
tools.description: Find animal volunteering missions in France (shelters, wildlife, horses) near a town, in a department or nationwide, from API Engagement data. Use it to help someone volunteer. Returns up to 25 missions with organisation, place, dates and the Mission Museaux page to apply. Accepts French or English;

tools.name: trouver_aide_locale
tools.description: Find local help near a French town, postcode or listing: town hall (phone, hours, pound), nearest vets, shelters and pounds within 50 km, neutering aid. Use it after a pet is lost or found. Returns up to 10 places with distance, phone, hours, source; open data, call first. Accepts French or English;
